title: Best app for neurodivergent minds
body: I never leave reviews, but this app deserves one, cause it’s incredible. Thank you for creating an alternative to all the endless calendar-task-planners that always make me feel like I can’t do it. This app is complex and has loads of possibilities, yet feels calm and gives my adhd brain a much needed sense of control and overview.
author: Sambalbee

title: One of the best task managers with a positive twist
body:
For a couple of years I am looking for a good app for a To-do list for private and work related tasks and reminders. Finally i found one that matches my requirements.

I had to adjust my way of planning tasks and reminders, but in a positive way. I also really like that you can define your (daily) habits.
author: RoyvBuuren

title: Looks great.
body: Nice, intuitive app. Dateformatting can’t be changed so I deleted the app. Shame, would have loved to try it more. In my country we write dates as dd-mm-yyyy.
author: PeterPekel

title: Okay, but can be better.
body: The app itself works for seeing items on my to do list, but overall it’s quite slow and clunky. The navigation is unintuitive and can take several seconds to react. I think Lunatask itself is a great service and pay for premium, but for now I’ll leave actual planning and usage to the desktop app and just rely on mobile for when I need to see what’s next.
author: p0op

title: Love it!
body:
I recently switched from Todoist and really love the simplicity and focus on one task at a time and the prioritisation features.

An additional benefit is the end to end encryption. Tasks are so personal to my life that I'd really hate to have a data leak or hack expose pretty much my entire life to anyone – that's a risk with any other task app I know, but end to end encryption means it's virtually impossible.
author: Willem Roest

title: Amazing!
body: I am always looking for an app where I can just everything that goes on in my brain leave at one place. I got ADHD and I really need to clear my thoughts a couple of times a day. With lunatask I can create all of my to do's, habits, journal and take notes. And schedule. Like WOW. I needed this!!!!! I just miss the app for IOS but I will wait patiently.
author: janoubaarda
